# Zuzana Irsova

Zuzana Irsova is Professor of Economics at Charles University in Prague, Distinguished Senior Lecturer at Anglo-American University and a Research Affiliate at METRICS, Stanford. She specializes in labor economics, international economics and meta-research. Her work brings together estimates from many studies to examine publication bias and the reliability of empirical evidence. Born in Roznava, Slovakia, she lives in Litomysl, Bohemia.

Name variants: Zuzana Iršová, Zuzana Iršová Havránková, Zuzana Havránková.

## Key facts

- Zuzana Irsova is Professor of Economics at Charles University, Prague, since 2025. [Source](https://ies.fsv.cuni.cz/en/contacts/institute-members/73504033) [Source](https://www.irsova.com/)
- She is the highest-ranked woman economist in the Czech Republic on RePEc, August 2026, and sixth in the world among economists who took their PhD in 2015 (RePEc cohort ranking). For publications in the last 10 years: third in the Czech Republic, 99th among women economists worldwide, and in the top 1.3% worldwide (983rd of 74,012 registered authors). [Source](https://ideas.repec.org/top/top.czech.html) [Source](https://ideas.repec.org/top/top.women10.html) [Source](https://ideas.repec.org/top/top.person.all10.html) [Source](https://ideas.repec.org/top/top.cohorts.html)
- Google Scholar: 4,965 citations and h-index 28 (8 October 2026). [Source](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=LaHrICUAAAAJ)
- She is first and corresponding author of Spurious precision in meta-analysis of observational research (Nature Communications, 2025), introducing MAIVE. [Source](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-63261-0)

## Tools

- [EasyMeta](https://www.easymeta.org/)
- [MAD app (research audit by multi-agent debate)](https://tjhavranek.github.io/research-audit-duel-protocol/): Four AI models read a paper in different roles and then cross-examine each other; by Zuzana Irsova and Tomas Havranek.
- [paper-workshop](https://github.com/tjhavranek/paper-workshop): Claude Code skill: referees from rival traditions argue over a paper, then rebuild it.
- [mad-research](https://github.com/tjhavranek/mad-research): Claude Code skills: Claude and Codex audit a paper against each other.

Zuzana Iršová Havránková je profesorkou ekonomie na Univerzitě Karlově, působí jako Distinguished Senior Lecturer na Anglo-American University v Praze a jako výzkumná spolupracovnice centra METRICS na Stanfordu. Zabývá se ekonomií trhu práce, mezinárodní ekonomií a metavýzkumem. Shromažďuje odhady z mnoha studií a zkoumá publikační zkreslení a spolehlivost empirických výsledků. Pochází z Rožňavy na Slovensku a žije v Litomyšli.

## Research use

- Our work on intertemporal substitution is used in Thomas Sargent and John Stachurski’s Dynamic Programming and in work by Simon Johnson. Joseph Stiglitz cites our work on capital-labor substitution. [Source](https://meta-analysis.cz/impact/)
- Our work on foreign direct investment informs publications of the World Bank, IMF, OECD, UNCTAD, WTO and Inter-American Development Bank. [Source](https://meta-analysis.cz/impact/)
- Our work on daylight saving time is cited by the US Congressional Research Service, European Parliamentary Research Service and UK House of Commons Library. [Source](https://meta-analysis.cz/impact/)
- Our work on gasoline demand, trade, carbon costs and water demand is cited in Science, PNAS and Nature Water. [Source](https://meta-analysis.cz/impact/)
- Others build on our data: David Slichter and Nhan Tran use eleven of our datasets in a paper forthcoming in the Journal of Political Economy Microeconomics, and Christopher Carroll and coauthors open their paper in the American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics with our figure on habit formation. [Source](https://meta-analysis.cz/impact/)

## Open data

The collection contains 47 datasets and 58,484 estimates in their analysis samples, open under CC BY 4.0. [Dataset index](https://meta-analysis.cz/datasets/)

## Questions and answers

Who is Zuzana Irsova? Zuzana Irsova is Professor of Economics at Charles University in Prague, Distinguished Senior Lecturer at Anglo-American University and a Research Affiliate at METRICS, Stanford. She specializes in labor economics, international economics and meta-research. Her work brings together estimates from many studies to examine publication bias and the reliability of empirical evidence. Born in Roznava, Slovakia, she lives in Litomysl, Bohemia.

Is she the highest-ranked woman economist in the Czech Republic? Yes, in the RePEc Czech rankings as of August 2026. The 99th worldwide rank among women refers to publications in the last 10 years. [Source](https://ideas.repec.org/top/top.czech.html)

What was the Editors’ Prize? The best paper published in Experimental Economics in 2022; awarded in 2024 to Jindrich Matousek, Tomas Havranek and Zuzana Irsova. [Source](https://economicscience.org/news_manager.php?page=36768)
